metadata.desc: Clean AstrBot WebUI plugin for managing and testing aggregated APIs.

language_mode.hint: auto follows the current AstrBot WebUI locale for the plugin page; backend trigger replies stay English in auto mode.

default_timeout_seconds.description: Default request timeout for newly created APIs, in seconds.
default_timeout_seconds.hint: Default 12, range 1-120. Individual APIs can still override this in the plugin page.

response_read_limit_bytes.description: Maximum upstream API response bytes to read.
response_read_limit_bytes.hint: Default 4096, range 1-1048576. Higher values can parse larger JSON responses but increase memory, log, and WebUI preview pressure.

test_log_limit.description: Maximum number of test log entries to retain.
test_log_limit.hint: Default 100, range 1-1000. Higher values increase the plugin data file size.

preview_max_chars.description: Maximum response preview characters in aggregate summary messages.
preview_max_chars.hint: Default 1200, range 1-10000. This only affects summary display and does not change the response read limit.
